name: TMPWordHighlighter
src_typeComment: Drop on any TMP_Text object, list the words to highlight and their colors — highlights are applied by recoloring vertices on the existing text mesh (no extra Image objects, no layout changes).

src_serialized.name: highlights
src_serialized.tooltip: Words to highlight and the color to tint them. Re-applied automatically whenever the text changes.

src_members.name: ApplyHighlights
src_members.comment: Call this directly if you change `highlights` from code at runtime.  The isApplying guard prevents an EDITOR-CRASHING recursion: ForceMeshUpdate() below makes TMP raise TEXT_CHANGED_EVENT, which this component subscribes to, whose handler calls straight back into here — ApplyHighlights -> ForceMeshUpdate -> TEXT_CHANGED_EVENT -> OnTextChanged -> ApplyHighlights -> ... unbounded recursion into a stack overflow. A managed stack overflow is not catchable in Unity: it takes the whole Editor down with nothing in the console. Same bug existed in TMPWaveEffect.
